tasks.title: optimize the slow dashboard
tasks.notes: Tier 2. Root cause: library-value.ts prices every game live behind the shared 250ms limiter; achievements awaited on the blocking path; no cache single-flight (ERR-0003). MERGE POINT: server/jobs/snapshot.ts (with 07) + server/cache.ts (with 02). One new migration for the pre-computed aggregate.

tasks.title: deploy to Vercel (Postgres, cron, env, button)
tasks.notes: Tier 3 (ship last). Absorbs #45 (one-click button). Blockers: SQLite->Postgres (provider switch + db push, migrations immutable), no vercel.json, cron reads x-cron-secret/POST but Vercel sends Authorization: Bearer/GET, build doesn't provision DB, Redis unimplemented. MERGE POINT: snapshot.ts + cache.ts. Real deploy + Vercel env is the human's step.

tasks.title: add History + Friends to the sidebar
tasks.notes: Tier 0 (quick, independent). Root cause: SidebarNav.tsx items array omits History/Friends though NavLinks.tsx already has them; stale 'intentionally omitted' docblock. Both routes are real + middleware-protected.

tasks.title: compare: fix 'shared games can't be computed'
tasks.notes: Tier 1. SHIPS WITH 05 IN ONE PR (shared root cause, same file). Root cause: app/compare/page.tsx defaults side A to getEnv().STEAM_ID = placeholder 76561190000000000 (non-existent account) -> games null -> 'Try again shortly'. Missed in Phase 6 #81 session migration. Fix: getViewerSteamId().

tasks.title: compare: don't render a raw SteamID as a name
tasks.notes: Tier 1. SHIPS WITH 04 IN ONE PR. Root cause: same placeholder origin as 04, plus independent display fallback (personaName ?? steamId) renders a 17-digit id as a name when profile is null. Fix: friendly fallback token, never /^\d{17}$/.

tasks.title: genres empty until re-sync: gate on onboarding
tasks.notes: Tier 1. Root cause: ownedGame rows only written by runOnboardingBackfill (onboarding/re-sync); auth signIn doesn't backfill and nothing gates a not-yet-onboarded session to /onboarding, so /insights/genres shows 'No genre data yet' until re-sync. Fix: gate on User.onboardedAt. Do NOT add fan-out to render.

tasks.title: Year in Review: achievements unlocked is 0
tasks.notes: Tier 1. Root cause: count is a delta of cumulative unlockedCount snapshots; <=1 snapshot/year (onboarding seeds no achievement baseline) -> 0. Real per-achievement unlockedAt is discarded. Fix: count by unlockedAt UTC year via a new AchievementUnlock table written by the nightly job. MERGE POINT: snapshot.ts (with 01/02). One new migration.

tasks.title: add a browser/tab icon (favicon)
tasks.notes: Tier 0 (quick, independent). Root cause: no favicon at all (no app/icon.*, no public/, no metadata.icons). Fix: file-based app/icon.svg (or app/icon.tsx) reproducing the amber-dot brand mark (#e8a05c). SVG escapes the *.ts(x) gate -> use icon.tsx or add a head test.
